name: Circle of Stars
summary: Druids who read the night sky and take a radiant starry form.

features.name: Star Map
features.short: Learn Guidance; cast Guiding Bolt for free.
features.summary: You create a star map that works as a spellcasting focus. You know Guidance and always have Guiding Bolt prepared, and you can cast Guiding Bolt without a slot PB times per long rest.

features.name: Starry Form
features.short: Spend Wild Shape: Archer, Chalice or Dragon constellation.
features.summary: As a bonus action, expend Wild Shape to take a starry form for 10 minutes. Archer: bonus action ranged spell attack for 1d8 + WIS radiant. Chalice: healing spells heal a second creature 1d8 + WIS. Dragon: treat 9 or lower as 10 on INT/WIS checks and concentration saves.

features.name: Cosmic Omen
features.short: After a long rest, roll for Weal (add d6) or Woe (subtract d6) reactions.
features.summary: After a long rest, roll a die: even gives Weal (reaction: add 1d6 to a creature's roll), odd gives Woe (reaction: subtract 1d6). Uses: PB per long rest.

features.name: Twinkling Constellations
features.short: Starry form gets stronger; Dragon form gives flight.
features.summary: Your Archer and Chalice dice become 2d8, the Dragon gives a 20 ft. flying speed with hover, and you can change constellation at the start of each turn.

features.name: Full of Stars
features.short: Resist bludgeoning, piercing and slashing in starry form.
features.summary: While in your starry form, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
